The closest matches are papers on self-improving AI systems that create their own training or evaluation signals without human labels. NRT trains reasoning models from standard question-answer pairs by having the model generate its own reasoning traces and using a self-reinforcing feedback loop, without expert-written demonstrations [5]. CoNL also targets tasks without ground-truth labels by using multi-agent self-play and meta-evaluation, where critiques are rewarded if they help others improve [8].

If you mean improving rule-following or agent behavior from weak or no labels, SynAct allocates feedback to the most consequential decisions and distills corrections into reusable rules [3], while RoboPhD and RuleEvolve use iterative performance feedback to evolve Text-to-SQL agents and coding rules autonomously [6, 10].
